title: Allosteric and Dominant-Negative Effects in a p53 Core Heterotetramer.
authors: Zhou, Han; Zhou, Tao; Yan, Shiwei
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过全原子分子动力学模拟研究p53核心异源四聚体中R249S突变引起的别构效应和显性负效应，聚焦突变体与野生型亚基间的蛋白-DNA结合界面动态互作机制，属于TF-DNA互作体系的高匹配度物理模拟研究。
abstract: The tumor suppressor protein p53 is one of the most frequently mutated proteins in cancer cells and is a critical target for anticancer therapies. In the nucleus, the p53 core domain binds DNA response elements as a tetramer to regulate gene transcription. During early cancer development, mutant and wild-type p53 coexist and assemble into a heterotetramer. Experimental studies confirm that the R249S mutant exerts a dominant-negative effect on wild-type p53, but the underlying molecular mechanisms, particularly how allosteric inhibition mediates the effect, remain unclear. Here, we employed all-atom molecular dynamics simulations to investigate how the R249S mutation causes dominant-negative effects in the p53 heterotetramer. Our simulations show that the mutation drives the reorganization of interfacial interactions in the heterotetramer through multiple allosteric pathways. Interestingly, the wild-type subunit forms more stable interactions with the mutant subunit than it does with wild-type subunits to adapt to the negative effects induced by the mutation in the protein.
abstract_zh: 肿瘤抑制蛋白p53是癌细胞中最常发生突变的蛋白质之一，也是抗癌治疗的关键靶点。在细胞核中，p53核心结构域以四聚体形式结合DNA响应元件以调控基因转录。在癌症早期发展过程中，突变型和野生型p53共存并组装成异源四聚体。实验研究证实，R249S突变体对野生型p53发挥显性负效应，但其潜在的分子机制，特别是别构抑制如何介导该效应，仍不清楚。在此，我们采用全原子分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟来研究R249S突变如何在p53异源四聚体中引起显性负效应。我们的模拟表明，该突变通过多条别构通路驱动异源四聚体中界面相互作用的重新组织。有趣的是，野生型亚基与突变型亚基形成的相互作用比与野生型亚基之间形成的相互作用更稳定，以适应突变在蛋白质中诱导的负效应。
